  367 Battle::AbilityEffects::OnHPDroppedBelowHalf.add(:EMERGENCYEXIT,
  368   proc { |ability, battler, move_user, battle|
  369     next false if battler.effects[PBEffects::SkyDrop] >= 0 ||
  370                   battler.inTwoTurnAttack?("TwoTurnAttackInvulnerableInSkyTargetCannotAct")   # Sky Drop
  371     # In wild battles
  372     if battle.wildBattle?
  373       next false if battler.opposes? && battle.pbSideBattlerCount(battler.index) > 1
  374       next false if !battle.pbCanRun?(battler.index)
  375       battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(battler, true)
  376       battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(battler)
  377       pbSEPlay("Battle flee")
  378       battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} fled from battle!", battler.pbThis))
  379       battle.decision = 3   # Escaped
  380       next true
  381     end
  382     # In trainer battles
  383     next false if battle.pbAllFainted?(battler.idxOpposingSide)
  384     next false if !battle.pbCanSwitchOut?(battler.index)   # Battler can't switch out
  385     next false if !battle.pbCanChooseNonActive?(battler.index)   # No Pokémon can switch in
  386     battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(battler, true)
  387     battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(battler)
  388     if !Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
  389       battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} activated!", battler.pbThis, battler.abilityName))
  390     end
  391     battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} went back to {2}!",
  392        battler.pbThis, battle.pbGetOwnerName(battler.index)))
  393     if battle.endOfRound   # Just switch out
  394       battle.scene.pbRecall(battler.index) if !battler.fainted?
  395       battler.pbAbilitiesOnSwitchOut   # Inc. primordial weather check
  396       next true
  397     end
  398     newPkmn = battle.pbGetReplacementPokemonIndex(battler.index)   # Owner chooses
  399     next false if newPkmn < 0   # Shouldn't ever do this
  400     battle.pbRecallAndReplace(battler.index, newPkmn)
  401     battle.pbClearChoice(battler.index)   # Replacement Pokémon does nothing this round
  402     battle.moldBreaker = false if move_user && battler.index == move_user.index
  403     battle.pbOnBattlerEnteringBattle(battler.index)
  404     next true
  405   }
